title: Sequencing: registry files
bodyMd:
Five files are reviewed in sequence. Each review is completed before the next begins.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Amber, Coral, Jade, Opal, Pearl.

- Amber and Pearl must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.
- Jade must precede Coral.
- Jade must not be in position 1.
- Opal must not be in position 3.
